name: GenTech Discount Rules – BOGO & Free Gifts
author: gentechtreedesign

sections.description:
GenTech Discount Rules transforms your WooCommerce store into a powerful promotional machine with advanced BOGO (Buy One Get One) offers, smart cart discounts, and intelligent checkout rules. Perfect for stores looking to increase average order value and conversion rates.

Documentation

📖 Read the full documentation here: step-by-step setup, every condition and reward, starter templates, developer hooks and troubleshooting.

Key Features

  • BOGO Offers: Create Buy One Get One promotions with flexible conditions
  • Cart Discounts: Apply fixed amount or percentage discounts to cart totals
  • Bulk / Tiered Pricing: “Buy 5+, save 10% each; buy 10+, save 15%” for a product or category
  • Coupon-Code Offers: Unlock a free gift or discount with a code, with no WooCommerce coupon to create
  • Smart Conditions: Set up rules based on products, product categories, cart subtotal, cart quantity, or a coupon code
  • Priority System: Control which promotions apply first
  • Limit Controls: Prevent abuse with usage limits and restrictions

Features

  • BOGO promotions (Buy X Get X / Buy X Get Y) based on a specific product or category in the cart
  • Cart discounts (fixed amount and percentage)
  • Bulk pricing for a product or category: % or fixed amount off each item, with multiple quantity tiers (highest tier reached wins)
  • Conditions: specific product in cart, product category in cart, cart subtotal threshold, total cart quantity, coupon code applied
  • Coupon-code rules register their code automatically, so customers can enter it in the cart without you creating a WooCommerce coupon
  • Usage limits per rule
  • Priority management and “stop other rules” to prevent discount stacking
  • One-click starter templates (Buy 2 Get 1, Buy A Get B, spend-and-save, free gift, buy more save more, coupon-code gift)
  • Rule scheduling (start/end dates)
  • Smart promotion messages with live placeholders (“Spend {remaining_amount} more to get {free_product} free!”) before and after the customer qualifies
  • Require login / exclude sale items from BOGO

Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores looking to increase sales
  • Businesses running promotional campaigns
  • Stores running quantity-based or code-based offers
sections.installation:
1. Upload the gentech-promo-engine folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to GenTech Discount Rules → Promotion Rules to create your first promotion
  4. Configure your promotions using the intuitive interface
sections.faq:
Does this work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes, GenTech Discount Rules is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme. It uses standard WooCommerce hooks and functions.

Can I use multiple promotions at once?

Yes, GenTech Discount Rules includes a priority system that allows you to control which promotions apply first when multiple conditions are met.

Is there a limit to how many promotions I can create?

No, you can create unlimited promotions using all of the condition types and actions listed above.

Does this affect site performance?

GenTech Discount Rules caches active rules and only does work while the cart is being calculated, so the impact on page speed is minimal.

Do I need to create a WooCommerce coupon for coupon-code offers?

No. When a rule uses the “Coupon Code Applied” condition, the plugin registers that code for you. If a real WooCommerce coupon with the same code exists, the real coupon is used instead.

How do bulk pricing tiers work?

Add one “Bulk Discount” reward row per tier for the same product or category, for example 5+ = 10% and 10+ = 15%. Quantities are counted across all matching items in the cart, and the highest tier reached applies to each of them.

Can I use this with other coupon plugins?

Yes, GenTech Discount Rules is compatible with most other WooCommerce and coupon plugins. However, we recommend testing to ensure compatibility with your specific setup.
